description: Compute Buyer's Stamp Duty (BSD) and Additional Buyer's Stamp Duty (ABSD) in SGD for a Singapore residential purchase, given the price or value, buyer type (singaporean | pr | foreigner | entity | trust) and the number of residential properties already owned. For the full upfront cost of a purchase, use `calculate_purchase_cost`.

buyerType.description: Residency or legal status of the buyer (citizen, permanent resident, foreigner, company or trust); sets the ABSD rate.

existingPropertiesOwned.description: Count of residential properties the buyer already owns (sets the ABSD tier).

price.description: Purchase price or market value (whichever higher), in SGD.

propertyType.description: Type of residential property being bought. It does not change the result: BSD and ABSD depend on price, buyer and properties already owned.

purchaseType.description: How the property will be held. `entity` (a company) or `trust` applies that ABSD rate whatever `buyerType` says; for the individual options the rate follows `buyerType`.

name: calculate_residential_stamp_duty

absd.description: Additional Buyer’s Stamp Duty, in SGD.

absdRate.description: ABSD rate applied, as a decimal fraction (0.2 = 20%).

totalBuyerStampDuty.description: Total stamp duty (BSD + ABSD), in SGD.

title: Residential stamp duty (BSD + ABSD)
